explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations set the minimum investment amount per non-accredited client at Rs. 50 lakh, which is the prescribed PMS ticket size for ordinary investors. The Trap: Candidates may confuse PMS with AIF (Rs. 1 crore) or with much smaller mutual-fund/retail thresholds. The Rs. 50 lakh figure is specific to PMS clients who do not qualify as Accredited Investors. Note: The Accredited Investor regime separately allows lower minimums for clients who are formally accredited; always verify AI status and documentation before treating a client as eligible for a sub-Rs. 50 lakh PMS arrangement.
